{{Top}}
'''Thykarann''' was a language related to [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] spoken by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] species from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

Thykarann was mainly used for technical talk, because its lexicon was considered rich in these fields. Comparatively, Shyriiwook was seen as too emotive. However, apparently, any person fluent in Shyriiwook could easily understand Thykarann.
